_comment: Which product categories are worth spending optimization budget on. Set 2026-08-03: narrowed to lotion only. Lotion is $1,801 of $2,919 trailing-90d product revenue (62%) — the rest of the catalogue splits the remaining 38% thinly, and every refresh costs real output tokens. Terms are matched as substrings against a page's target keyword using the vocabulary in lib/product-scope.js. Set "terms" to null to fall back to "every category with any recorded revenue".
reviewNote: 60-day trial. At review, re-run the trailing-90d revenue-by-term breakdown and decide whether to widen (coconut oil $589, soap $473, moisturizer $276 were next) or hold.
